create.name: Joshua Canter
create.bio:
Joshua Canter is a mindfulness meditation teacher based in Asheville, North Carolina, who has been leading meditation since around 2000. He studied Contemplative Psychology to MA level, specialising in mindfulness, and names Thich Nhat Hanh, Jack Kornfield, Tara Brach, Roshi Joan Halifax, Ram Dass and Amma among the teachers who have shaped his practice. Alongside his teaching he co-founded True Nature Travels, an Asheville company that has organised group retreats around the world for more than twenty years.

His teaching keeps mindfulness simple and practical: present-moment awareness, breath, loving-kindness and walking practice, drawn from several contemplative traditions. In Asheville he leads a weekly drop-in class and quiet early-morning sessions of seated and walking meditation in the galleries of the Asheville Art Museum, and he has taught in schools, hospitals, hospice settings and workplaces, as well as offering private sessions. His recorded collection Mindfulness Now gathers guided practices including metta, a body scan and the Tibetan phowa set to an ambient soundscape, and his meditations and a six-day course are free to explore on Insight Timer.

courses.title: The Mindfulness Now L.I.F.E. Course
courses.description: A six-day audio course on Insight Timer introducing Joshua's approach to everyday mindfulness. Each session combines a short teaching with a guided practice.
courses.price: Included in Member Plus ($59.99 USD a year)

courses.title: The Art of Presence: Meditation and Reflection in the Museum
courses.description: Early-morning sessions at the Asheville Art Museum before it opens, beginning with seated meditation and moving into a mostly silent walking practice through the galleries. Prompts invite you to notice your own response to the art; no experience needed.
courses.price: $15.00 USD per session (free for museum members)

courses.title: Private mindfulness sessions, classes and workshops
courses.description: One-to-one mindfulness sessions shaped around the individual, plus class series and workshops that Joshua runs for schools, businesses and other groups on request. Get in touch through his site to arrange.

free_resources.title: Joshua Canter on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Free guided meditations from Joshua, including loving-kindness, breath awareness, a body scan and mantra practice, with instrumental versions too.
